summary.text:
# 冰冻冰巨星 / Ice Ice Giant

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration (C3)

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 6级异常，权重3；气态巨行星，无战略资源，且所有者拥有tech_mine_zro或旗标zroni_intro。  
  Level-6 anomaly, weight 3; gas giants without strategic resources whose owner has tech_mine_zro or the zroni_intro flag.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 单一结局150“零度之下”（研究）：清除资源点并添加佐罗（Zro）战略资源，1天后触发action.941。  
  Single outcome 150 (research): clears deposits and adds the Zro strategic resource; action.941 follows after 1 day.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 线性，单一结局。  
  Linear, single outcome.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无特别差异。  
  No notable variants.
